task.title: Relics: `sync --status` lists the relic conflicts a watcher holds
task.description:
A relic is a record in Workbook beside tasks. It holds specs, plans, decisions and similar material as named parts, with the same history and sharing that tasks have.

This is a follow-up from the review of the first six relics stories (finding M16). It was left out of that work on purpose.

## Problem

`workbook sync --status` does not list the relic conflicts a running watcher has recorded. Someone who polls status cannot see them; they appear only on the next command that opens a session. The reference documents this gap.

## Wanted

Copy the watcher's relic conflicts into the status result, in text and in JSON.

## Done when

- `workbook sync --status --json` carries the same relic conflict entries a later command would show.
- The reference no longer lists this as a gap.
